title: uf/{head_id}/score payload
description: UPSERT payload of uf/{head_id}/score. Clearing the score is a DELETE. Serialized, at most 134 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

score.description: The user's rating out of 10, as MFC scores it.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
